findings.claim: --host grok installs the harness (and a grok verifier.md that now teaches bash "$HOME/.claude/saikit-tools/saikit-blast.sh") but never plants ~/.claude/saikit-tools. The plant lives only inside instalar_recetas_claude, which runs for --host claude and the default (HOST empty) path. A grok-only install exits 0 with the contract pointing at tools that do not exist.

findings.claim: path_present_under_root uses logical pwd (not pwd -P / cygpath), so the under-PROJECT_ROOT check accepts a .saikit/decisiones directory that is a symlink to a path outside the project. The same hook already documented this class for adversary paths (C:/ vs /c/, Darwin /var vs /private/var) at the ADV_PROJECT_CANON block and did not reuse that machinery.
